calibrationThisPeriodSection.calibrationThisPeriod: All four instance flow meters were calibrated in December 2026 by an accredited provider; certificates retained.

monitoringPersonnelSection.monitoringPersonnel: Operations Manager (responsible for monitoring), four trained zone technicians (data collection), one data clerk (entry and reconciliation).

nonConformancesThisPeriodSection.nonConformancesThisPeriod: One missing monthly reading (Zone 3, July 2027) was logged, traced to a technician absence and corrected from the meter's cumulative register.

samplingThisPeriodSection.samplingThisPeriod: Appliance functionality and water quality sampled per the CDM Standard: Sampling and Surveys (384 households for the annual survey; 40 households for the biennial water quality check).

mrBaselineEmissions.beEquation: BE_y = QPW_y x m x X_boil x SEC x SUM_i BL_fuel,i x ((EF_CO2,i x fNRB,i) + EF_nonCO2,i) x 10^-9 x Adj_LE (VMR0015 Eq.(1)); fNRB = 1 for fossil fuels. SEC = [WH x (T_f - T_i) + 0.01 x WHE] / eta_wb (AMS-III.AV Eq.(4)) or 357.48 / eta_wb (Eq.(5)), as selected in Appendix 2.

mrProjectEmissions.peEquation: PE_y = PE_FF,y + PE_EC,y (AMS-III.AV Eq.(6)). PE_FF,y = FC_i,y x COEF_i,y (CDM TOOL03 Eq.(1)), with COEF = w_C x 44/12 (Option A, mass, Eq.(2)), w_C x rho x 44/12 (Option A, volume, Eq.(3)) or NCV x EF_CO2 (Option B, Eq.(4)). PE_EC,y follows Verra VT0010 v1.1, which replaces CDM TOOL05 for this methodology (VMR0015 s8.2): PE_EC,y = PE_A + PE_B + PE_C, with PE_A = EC_PE,A x EF_A x (1 + TDL_A) (Eq.(5), (7)), EC_PE,B = MIN(EC_Grid ; EG_PBWA / (1 + TDL_B)) (Eq.(9)), PE_B per Eq.(8) and shared plants per Eq.(11), (13), (14). EC is in MWh/yr and EF in t CO2/MWh, so PE is in t CO2/yr.

mrLeakage.leakageEquation: LE_y = 0 (VMR0015 Sec8.3: non-renewable biomass leakage is folded into BE_y via Adj_LE, not added separately)
mrLeakage.leakageWorkedCalculation: LE_y = 0 tCO2e. No separate additive leakage term; VMR0015 Sec8.3 folds non-renewable biomass leakage into BE_y via Adj_LE.
